verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's own docs describe a self-hosted mode that runs the review agent inside your own infrastructure instead of CodeRabbit's cloud [coderabbit-docs-18]. The FAQ confirms self-hosted CodeRabbit is available on Enterprise, with the option to opt out of all data retention [coderabbit-supp-2]. missing for 10: deployment and installation details (supported platforms, requirements, LLM/model hosting), clarity on whether self-hosting covers features beyond the review agent, availability outside Enterprise, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
